order: A dish is earlier than another when its level is lower, or at the same level its n is lower, or at the same level and n its meal comes first in breakfast, lunch, dinner, dessert. buildsOn names only earlier dishes.

entries.title: Soft-Boiled Eggs with Toast Soldiers
skills: timing an egg to the minute
entries.why: The first lesson in the kitchen is that time and temperature decide everything, and a boiled egg shows it to the second.

entries.title: Fried Eggs, Basted and Over Easy
entries.why: Frying an egg three ways trains the eye to read a pan by sound and by the edge of the white.

entries.title: Oeufs Brouillés (French Scrambled Eggs)
skills: finishing with butter off the heat
entries.why: Slow French scrambled eggs teach patience on low heat and how far carryover cooking goes once the pan comes off.

entries.title: Masala Omelette
skills: fine dice of onion, chilli and tomato
entries.why: The first knife drill with a reward: a fine, even dice that cooks in the time the eggs set.

entries.title: The French Omelette
entries.why: The classic test of a cook, it asks for heat control and wrist work in under a minute.

entries.title: Çılbır (Turkish Poached Eggs)
skills: poaching eggs in barely moving water
entries.why: Poaching is the gentlest heat an egg meets, and the chilli butter is a first taste of infused fat.

entries.title: Bánh Mì Ốp La
skills: frying eggs with crisp lacy edges
entries.why: The street breakfast of Saigon puts the fried egg to work beside a quick pickle, the first sour note in the course.

entries.title: Huevos Rancheros
skills: a cooked tomato and chilli salsa
warming tortillas on a dry pan
entries.why: A first simple sauce built from charred tomato and chilli, finished with eggs cooked to order.

entries.title: Shakshuka
skills: poaching eggs in sauce under a lid
entries.why: Eggs poached in a reduced pepper and tomato sauce join two earlier lessons in one pan.

entries.title: Gyeran-jjim (Korean Steamed Egg)
entries.why: The first custard in the course is a savoury one, set by steam so the cook learns what a wobble means.

entries.title: Kaya Toast with Soft-Boiled Eggs
skills: a stirred coconut and egg custard
entries.why: Kaya is a stirred custard that must thicken without scrambling, the core skill behind every sweet custard to come.

entries.title: Scottish Oat Porridge
skills: stirring to a smooth, loose set
entries.why: Grains begin with porridge: the ratio of liquid to oats and the stirring that releases their starch.

entries.title: Bircher Muesli
skills: balancing sweet and sour without cooking
entries.why: A raw cousin of porridge that teaches soaking and the knife and grater work of a fruit garnish.

entries.title: Chicken Congee
entries.why: Congee shows how far a long, gentle simmer can transform rice and how garnish builds a bowl.

entries.title: Kiri Bath (Sri Lankan Milk Rice)
skills: cooking rice then finishing in coconut milk
pressing and cutting a set rice
entries.why: Milk rice teaches a rice that sets firm enough to slice, with a pounded onion and chilli relish.

entries.title: Tapsilog
skills: garlic fried rice from cold rice
entries.why: Three components on one plate, each simple, teach a cook to time the morning.

entries.title: Ful Medames
skills: dressing with lemon, cumin and oil
entries.why: Dried beans are the backbone of many cuisines, and ful teaches the soak, the simmer and the dressing.

entries.title: Ndambé (Senegalese Bean Sandwich)
skills: cooking black-eyed beans in a tomato base
entries.why: A West African breakfast of spiced beans that builds on the bean simmer with a sweated onion base.

entries.title: Mangú with Pickled Red Onions
entries.why: Starch handling moves from grains to plantain, mashed hot with its own water to a smooth finish.

entries.title: Changua (Colombian Milk and Egg Soup)
entries.why: Poaching in milk rather than water shows how a gentler liquid needs gentler heat.

entries.title: Buttermilk Pancakes
entries.why: The first quick batter, where chemical leavening and a light hand decide the whole result.

entries.title: Swedish Pancakes with Lingonberries
entries.why: A thin, unleavened batter teaches pan coating and the difference eggs make without baking soda.

entries.title: Syrniki
entries.why: Cheese fritters train the feel of a soft dough and the steady medium heat that browns without burning.

entries.title: Irish Soda Farls
skills: mixing only until it comes together
entries.why: The quickest bread there is, baked on a griddle, teaches that a soda dough wants as little handling as possible.

entries.title: Buttermilk Biscuits with Sausage Gravy
skills: a roux gravy from sausage fat
entries.why: The Southern breakfast joins a quick bread built on cold fat with a first milk gravy thickened by roux.

entries.title: Horiatiki (Greek Village Salad)
skills: cutting tomato, cucumber and onion cleanly
dressing with oil, vinegar and oregano
entries.why: A salad with no lettuce and nowhere to hide puts the knife first, which is where every cook begins.

entries.title: Tabbouleh
entries.why: A salad that is mostly parsley demands a sharp knife and a clean, slicing cut rather than a crush.

entries.title: Salade Niçoise
skills: boiling eggs and potatoes to time
entries.why: A composed salad of separately cooked parts introduces blanching and the oil and vinegar emulsion.

entries.title: Gazpacho Andaluz
skills: blending oil into a vegetable base
entries.why: A raw, chilled soup shows how olive oil emulsifies into vegetables and why cold food needs more salt.

entries.title: Gỏi Cuốn (Fresh Spring Rolls)
entries.why: Julienne and neat rolling are knife and hand skills that every later dumpling and roll relies on.

entries.title: Gado-Gado
entries.why: Blanching a whole market of vegetables in sequence and binding them with a peanut sauce builds timing.

entries.title: Smørrebrød
skills: balancing toppings on an open sandwich
entries.why: The Danish open sandwich is knife work and composition on a slice of rye.

entries.title: Miso Soup with Tofu and Wakame
skills: making dashi from kombu and katsuobushi
entries.why: Dashi is the shortest stock in the world and the gateway to Japanese cooking.

entries.title: Potato and Leek Soup
entries.why: Sweating leeks gently teaches flavour without browning, then the blender finishes the lesson.

entries.title: Mercimek Çorbası (Red Lentil Soup)
skills: simmering red lentils until they collapse
entries.why: The red lentil soup of Turkish lunch counters adds pulses and a spiced butter to the puréed soup.

entries.title: Tomato Soup and Grilled Cheese
skills: even browning of a sandwich over medium heat
entries.why: Two plain things done well, a soup with depth and a sandwich browned evenly without burning.

entries.title: Welsh Rarebit
entries.why: A cheese sauce that must not split, finished under the grill, is a first look at a sauce under heat.

entries.title: Pasta e Fagioli
skills: cooking pasta in the soup to thicken it
entries.why: The soffritto is the Italian base of everything, and starch from the pasta finishes the soup.

entries.title: Spaghetti Aglio, Olio e Peperoncino
entries.why: Garlic turns from sweet to bitter in seconds, so this five ingredient pasta is a lesson in heat control.

entries.title: Quesadillas with Pico de Gallo
skills: melting cheese on a dry comal
entries.why: A fresh salsa cut by hand and a tortilla crisped on a dry pan bring knife work and heat together.

entries.title: Arepas Reina Pepiada
entries.why: The arepa is the simplest dough in the course and a lesson in shaping by hand.

entries.title: Dal Tadka
skills: pouring the tadka at the end
entries.why: Tadka teaches the cook to hear spices bloom in hot fat, a technique that runs through Indian cooking.

entries.title: Mujadara
entries.why: Patiently browned onions are the whole flavour of this Levantine staple of lentils and rice.

entries.title: Red Red (Black-Eyed Bean Stew with Plantain)
skills: cooking beans in a palm oil tomato base
entries.why: Ghana's bean stew with fried ripe plantain adds shallow frying of fruit to the bean lesson.

entries.title: Red Beans and Rice
skills: a long bean simmer to creaminess
entries.why: New Orleans' Monday lunch teaches the trinity of onion, celery and pepper and a slow, creamy bean pot.

entries.title: Lecsó
skills: cooking down with tomato and paprika
entries.why: A pepper stew that shows paprika's character in fat and how long cooking sweetens peppers.

entries.title: Tomato and Egg Stir-Fry with Rice
skills: soft eggs cooked fast in hot oil
entries.why: The first wok dish in the course is the home cooking of China, eggs set in seconds then folded back.

entries.title: Kimchi Fried Rice (Kimchi Bokkeumbap)
entries.why: Fried rice teaches why cold, dry rice separates and fresh rice clumps.

entries.title: Pad Kra Pao Moo (Thai Holy Basil Stir-Fry)
entries.why: Thailand's favourite lunch is fast, loud wok cooking with a crisp, puffed fried egg.

entries.title: Oyakodon
entries.why: Eggs set gently in a seasoned broth bring dashi and egg control together in one bowl.

entries.title: Spaghetti al Pomodoro
entries.why: The simplest Italian dinner teaches reduction and the habit of finishing pasta in its sauce.

entries.title: Ratatouille
entries.why: Cooking each vegetable on its own before they meet teaches that ingredients cook at different speeds.

entries.title: Pollo al Ajillo
entries.why: Garlic chicken is the first browning and deglazing lesson, with a sherry pan sauce.

entries.title: Chicken Piccata
skills: a lemon and caper pan sauce mounted with butter
entries.why: A pan sauce built in the same pan after a dredged cutlet is a pattern used in every brigade.

entries.title: Shrimp Scampi
skills: a garlic, wine and butter sauce
entries.why: Shrimp cook in two minutes, which makes them the best teacher of doneness by colour and curl.

entries.title: Garides Saganaki
skills: a quick tomato sauce with ouzo
entries.why: Shrimp poached in tomato rather than seared shows a second way to protect a delicate protein.

entries.title: Blackened Redfish
entries.why: The hottest pan in the course teaches safety and the line between blackened spice and burnt.

entries.title: Pan-Fried Fish with Chermoula
skills: a herb, spice and lemon marinade
entries.why: A herb marinade and crisp skin teach fish cookery at moderate heat, the opposite of blackening.

entries.title: Wiener Schnitzel
skills: swirling in fat so the crumb puffs
entries.why: The breading station is a fundamental of every kitchen, and a puffed, rippled crust is its test.

entries.title: Kofta Kebabs with Yoghurt Sauce
skills: cooking under a hot grill or over coals
entries.why: Shaping and cooking minced meat evenly teaches seasoning by test patty and safe internal temperatures.

entries.title: Swedish Meatballs with Cream Sauce
entries.why: The panade explains why some meatballs stay tender, and the cream sauce extends the pan sauce lesson.

entries.title: Bangers and Mash with Onion Gravy
entries.why: A pub dinner teaches gentle sausage cookery, the right potato for mash and a gravy from browned onions.

entries.title: Dublin Coddle
entries.why: A pale, gentle stew from Dublin shows how a low simmer builds flavour without browning.

entries.title: Chicken Teriyaki
skills: a soy, mirin and sake glaze
entries.why: Teriyaki is reduction as a glaze, sticky enough to coat but not so far that it burns.

entries.title: Kung Pao Chicken
skills: frying dried chillies and Sichuan pepper
a balanced sweet and sour sauce
entries.why: A classic stir-fry teaches mise en place, because nothing can be cut once the wok is hot.

entries.title: Jeyuk Bokkeum (Spicy Stir-Fried Pork)
skills: stir-frying to caramelise without burning sugar
entries.why: Korean spicy pork introduces fermented chilli paste and the risk sugar brings to high heat.

entries.title: Gà Kho Gừng (Caramel Ginger Chicken)
skills: a dark caramel as a savoury base
entries.why: Vietnamese kho uses a caramel taken nearly to bitter, the first meeting with sugar stages.

entries.title: Chicken Adobo
entries.why: Adobo is a simmer in vinegar and soy that ends in a sear, the reverse of the usual order.

entries.title: Chana Masala
skills: an onion, ginger and tomato masala cooked until the oil separates
entries.why: The masala base, cooked until it releases its oil, is the foundation of North Indian cooking.

entries.title: Thai Green Curry with Chicken
skills: frying curry paste in cracked coconut cream
balancing fish sauce, palm sugar and lime
entries.why: Frying paste in coconut cream until the oil separates is the Thai cousin of the Indian masala.

entries.title: Maafe (Groundnut Stew)
entries.why: A West African stew thickened with groundnut paste teaches slow simmering and skimming.

entries.title: Beef Fajitas
entries.why: Skirt steak teaches the most important carving rule: slice across the grain.

entries.title: Picadillo Cubano
entries.why: The Cuban sofrito and the balance of salty and sweet make a fast weeknight dish a lesson in seasoning.

entries.title: Arroz con Pollo
skills: cooking rice with stock and saffron or achiote without stirring
entries.why: A one pot rice teaches the liquid ratio and the discipline of leaving rice alone.

entries.title: Shrimp and Grits
entries.why: Southern grits are a porridge for dinner, crowned with a shrimp pan sauce that pulls the level together.

entries.title: Poires à la Beaujolaise
skills: reducing the liquor to a syrup
entries.why: Poaching fruit is the gentlest dessert technique and teaches when a knife slides in cleanly.

entries.title: Lemon Posset with Shortbread Fingers
entries.why: Three ingredients set by lemon juice alone, beside a shortbread that teaches rubbing butter into flour.

entries.title: Panna Cotta
skills: unmoulding a set cream with a tremble
entries.why: Gelatine is measured to the gram here, because the goal is the softest set that still stands.

entries.title: Ginger Milk Curd
skills: heating milk to the right temperature
entries.why: A Cantonese pudding set by an enzyme in ginger teaches that temperature, not time, makes it work.

entries.title: Muhallabia
skills: perfuming with rose or orange blossom
entries.why: A starch-thickened milk pudding shows how cornflour must boil to thicken and lose its raw taste.

entries.title: Tembleque
skills: a coconut milk and cornstarch pudding
entries.why: The Puerto Rican coconut pudding repeats the starch set with coconut in place of dairy.

entries.title: Kheer
entries.why: Rice pudding brings the slow grain simmer to dessert, with milk that must never catch on the pan.

entries.title: Mango Sticky Rice
entries.why: Steamed glutinous rice and a salted coconut cream show how salt sharpens sweetness.

entries.title: Chè Chuối (Banana and Coconut Tapioca)
entries.why: A Vietnamese sweet soup teaches tapioca starch and how coconut desserts are seasoned with salt.

entries.title: Thiakry
entries.why: A Senegalese grain dessert brings steamed millet and cultured milk together cold.

entries.title: Brigadeiros
skills: cooking condensed milk until it pulls from the pan
entries.why: Brazil's party sweet is a pure lesson in heat control and reading thickness as the pan is tilted.

entries.title: Crêpes
skills: the first crêpe as a test
entries.why: The French crêpe refines the thin pancake with a rested batter and the first lesson in a well seasoned pan.

entries.title: Kaiserschmarrn
skills: tearing and caramelising in the pan
entries.why: A torn Austrian pancake introduces whipped whites and folding without losing air.

entries.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
entries.why: The first bake on a tray teaches creaming, why rested dough spreads less and the carryover of a hot tray.

entries.title: Anzac Biscuits
entries.why: A melted-butter biscuit is the counterpoint to creaming and shows how bicarbonate reacts with syrup.

entries.title: Cantucci di Prato
entries.why: Twice baking explains how dryness keeps a biscuit crisp for weeks.

entries.title: Fudgy Brownies
skills: beating eggs and sugar for a crackled top
entries.why: Melting chocolate without seizing and judging an underbake by skewer are skills used to the top level.

entries.title: Victoria Sponge
entries.why: The British teatime sponge is the purest test of creaming, where air beaten in becomes the rise.

entries.title: Tarta de Santiago
skills: whisking eggs and sugar to the ribbon
ground almonds in place of flour
entries.why: An almond cake raised by whisked eggs shows a second way to put air into a cake.

entries.title: Malva Pudding
skills: pouring a hot cream syrup over a hot cake
entries.why: South Africa's soaked pudding teaches how a hot sponge drinks a hot syrup.

entries.title: Peach Cobbler
skills: baking until bubbling at the centre
entries.why: The Southern cobbler puts a rubbed-in biscuit dough over juicy, thickened fruit.

entries.title: Smulpaj (Swedish Crumble Pie)
entries.why: The Swedish crumble pie extends rubbing in to a free crumble with the warmth of cardamom.

entries.title: Key Lime Pie
skills: a custard set by lime acid and a short bake
entries.why: Acid thickening returns from the posset, now in a baked custard with a pressed crumb crust.

entries.title: Leche Flan
skills: baking or steaming gently in a water bath
entries.why: The Filipino flan unites caramel and a gently set custard, the two pillars of classic desserts.

entries.title: Basque Burnt Cheesecake
skills: very high heat for a caramelised top
entries.why: A custard baked hot rather than gently shows how far the wobble can be pushed for a molten centre.

entries.title: Tamagoyaki
skills: cooking thin layers in a square pan
rolling and pressing in a mat
entries.why: Rolling an omelette in layers is the next step in egg control after the French omelette.

entries.title: Tortilla Española
skills: poaching potatoes slowly in olive oil
entries.why: Potatoes gently confited in oil and a thick tortilla flipped whole make a lesson in low heat and nerve.

entries.title: Chilaquiles Verdes
entries.why: Frying tortillas to stay crisp in a sauce teaches timing to the minute between crunch and mush.

entries.title: Croque Madame
skills: a béchamel from roux and milk
entries.why: Béchamel is the first mother sauce, and the Parisian café sandwich is its most delicious exam.

entries.title: Galette Complète (Breton Buckwheat Crêpe)
skills: folding around ham, Gruyère and egg
entries.why: The Breton galette takes the crêpe to buckwheat, a gluten-free flour with its own handling.

entries.title: Kedgeree
entries.why: A Victorian breakfast of smoked fish and spiced rice introduces poaching fish gently.

entries.title: Ackee and Saltfish
skills: folding in ackee without breaking it
entries.why: Salt cod must be soaked and tasted, and canned ackee folded gently, a lesson in working with preserved food.

entries.title: Country Ham with Redeye Gravy
entries.why: Redeye gravy is a pan sauce at its most basic: fond lifted by coffee and nothing else.

entries.title: Full English Breakfast
skills: running several pans and the grill at once
entries.why: Eight components hot at once on one plate is the first real lesson in running a station.

entries.title: Grillades and Grits
entries.why: The New Orleans brunch classic is a true braise, and the first one in the course.

entries.title: Pan con Chicharrón
skills: simmering pork belly until the water cooks off and it fries in its own fat
entries.why: Pork belly that boils, then fries in its own rendered fat, teaches rendering from start to finish.

entries.title: Tiroler Gröstl
skills: parboiled potatoes crisped in a hot pan
entries.why: The Tyrolean hash shows how to crisp a cooked potato and use a roast twice.

entries.title: Boxty
entries.why: The Irish potato pancake combines raw and cooked potato, and teaches why water is the enemy of a crisp edge.

entries.title: Akara (Black-Eyed Bean Fritters)
skills: deep frying at a steady temperature safely
entries.why: The first deep frying in the course, with whipped bean batter that rises in the oil.

entries.title: Nasi Lemak
entries.why: Malaysia's national breakfast asks for four components and a sambal cooked down until it darkens.

entries.title: Chechebsa
skills: clarifying spiced butter for niter kibbeh
entries.why: Ethiopian spiced clarified butter introduces clarification, a skill every later sauce uses.

entries.title: Cachapas con Queso de Mano
skills: blending fresh corn to a batter
entries.why: Fresh corn behaves nothing like masa, and the cachapa teaches the difference.

entries.title: Cong You Bing (Scallion Pancakes)
skills: rolling, oiling, coiling and rolling again for layers
entries.why: A hot water dough coiled with oil and scallion is a first simple lamination.

entries.title: Aloo Paratha
entries.why: A stuffed flatbread teaches dough strength, filling dryness and an even roll.

entries.title: Karjalanpiirakka (Karelian Pies)
entries.why: Finnish rye pies teach rolling a gluten-poor dough paper thin and crimping by hand.

entries.title: Banitsa
skills: layering with egg, yoghurt and sirene
entries.why: Bulgaria's breakfast pie is the first work with phyllo, the thinnest dough a cook handles.

entries.title: Bánh Bao (Vietnamese Steamed Pork Buns)
skills: a pork, egg and wood ear filling
entries.why: Vietnam's breakfast bun is the first yeast dough cooked by steam rather than oven.

entries.title: Man'oushe Za'atar
entries.why: The Lebanese flatbread is the first yeast dough, where kneading and proofing decide the crumb.

entries.title: Blini with Smetana
entries.why: Blini join yeast and whipped whites in a batter, two kinds of rise in one bite.

entries.title: Sticky Buns
entries.why: An enriched dough with butter and egg proves slower and teaches patience, ending in caramel.

entries.title: Avgolemono Soup
skills: tempering egg and lemon with hot broth
entries.why: Stock begins here, finished with an egg and lemon liaison that must be tempered or it curdles.

entries.title: Chicken Noodle Soup from Scratch
skills: a white chicken stock from a whole bird
entries.why: A whole chicken simmered to a clear stock is the white stock of the classical kitchen at home.

entries.title: Hainanese Chicken Rice
skills: poaching a whole chicken below the simmer
an ice bath for gelatinous skin
rice cooked in stock and chicken fat
entries.why: Poaching a bird gently and using every part of it, stock, fat and meat, is a lesson in economy.

entries.title: Soupe à l'Oignon Gratinée
entries.why: French onion soup needs a brown stock and onions coloured slowly to mahogany.

entries.title: Barszcz Czerwony with Uszka
skills: tiny mushroom dumplings folded by hand
entries.why: The Polish Christmas Eve soup pairs a jewel-clear broth with the first folded dumplings.

entries.title: Gulyásleves (Goulash Soup)
skills: paprika added off the heat so it does not scorch
entries.why: The Hungarian herdsman's soup teaches that paprika burns in seconds and that beef must be cooked long.

entries.title: Lohikeitto (Finnish Salmon Soup)
skills: a quick fish stock from salmon frames
entries.why: Fish stock is quick, twenty minutes and no more, and this soup teaches why.

entries.title: Seafood Chowder with Brown Soda Bread
skills: adding fish in order of cooking time
entries.why: The Irish chowder thickens fish stock with roux and teaches adding seafood by cooking time.

entries.title: Chicken and Andouille Gumbo
skills: a dark roux stirred to chocolate
entries.why: The dark Cajun roux is the most demanding roux in the course and the soul of South Louisiana.

entries.title: Roast Beef Po' Boy with Debris Gravy
skills: making gravy from the drippings and debris
entries.why: The New Orleans sandwich teaches roasting, resting and a gravy from what falls off the roast.

entries.title: Croquetas de Jamón
entries.why: Spain's bar staple uses béchamel as a filling, a mother sauce pushed to its thickest.

entries.title: Cacio e Pepe
skills: a cheese paste emulsified off the heat
entries.why: Three ingredients and a sauce that breaks above about 149°F (65°C) make this Rome's exam in emulsions.

entries.title: Bibimbap
entries.why: A bowl of six separately seasoned vegetables builds the habit of tasting every component.

entries.title: Pad Thai
skills: a tamarind, fish sauce and palm sugar sauce
cooking in batches in a hot wok
entries.why: Pad Thai is an exercise in mise en place and batch size, because a crowded wok steams.

entries.title: Bánh Mì Thịt
entries.why: The full bánh mì adds roast pork and a simple pâté to the breakfast lesson.

entries.title: Tacos de Carnitas
skills: slow cooking pork in lard with orange
entries.why: Pork gently cooked in its own fat until it falls apart, then crisped, is confit in a Mexican accent.

entries.title: Falafel in Pita with Tahini Sauce
entries.why: Falafel teaches why soaked, uncooked chickpeas hold together and canned ones fall apart.

entries.title: Moin Moin
entries.why: The steamed bean pudding of Nigeria uses the akara purée in an entirely different way.

entries.title: Amritsari Chole with Bhature
entries.why: Punjab's favourite lunch deepens the chickpea masala and adds a dough that puffs in hot oil.

entries.title: Kitsune Udon with Hand-Made Noodles
skills: kneading by foot in a bag
entries.why: Udon dough is kneaded hard and cut by hand, the first noodle made from scratch in the course.

entries.title: Jiaozi (Pork and Napa Cabbage Dumplings)
skills: a hot or cold water dough
entries.why: Northern Chinese dumplings teach rolling a wrapper thin at the edge and pleating a seal.

entries.title: Empanadas Salteñas
skills: a juicy beef filling chilled firm
entries.why: The Argentine empanada uses a chilled filling and a hand crimp, pastry and dumpling skills combined.

entries.title: Cornish Pasties
skills: raw beef, potato, swede and onion layered
entries.why: A shortcrust strong enough to hold a raw filling through a long bake is pastry's first real test.

entries.title: Quiche Lorraine
skills: a just-set bacon and egg custard
entries.why: Blind baking a crisp shell and setting a custard with a tremble bring pastry and custard together.

entries.title: Pizza Margherita
entries.why: Pizza dough teaches hydration, cold fermentation and the effect of extreme oven heat.

entries.title: Poulet Rôti with Pan Gravy
skills: a pan gravy from the drippings
entries.why: A roast chicken is the dish chefs use to judge a cook, and the first whole-bird roast in the course.

entries.title: Chicken Pot Pie
skills: a velouté from roux and chicken stock
entries.why: Velouté, the second mother sauce, is stock thickened with roux, and the pot pie puts it under pastry.

entries.title: Moussaka
entries.why: The Greek bake layers three preparations and uses béchamel as a soufflé-like crown.

entries.title: Tagliatelle al Ragù
skills: a slow meat ragù with milk and wine
entries.why: Fresh egg pasta and a three hour ragù are the backbone of Emilian cooking.

entries.title: Linguine alle Vongole
skills: a clam juice and oil emulsion
entries.why: Live clams teach shellfish safety and a sauce made from their own juices.

entries.title: Cantonese Steamed Fish
skills: pouring smoking oil over ginger and scallion
entries.why: Steaming a whole fish just to the bone is a test of timing and freshness.

entries.title: Miso-Glazed Black Cod
skills: a saikyo miso marinade over days
a fierce overhead grill to caramelise without burning
entries.why: A long miso marinade and a fierce overhead grill teach how sugar and time season a rich fish.

entries.title: Bulgogi
skills: slicing beef paper thin from frozen
entries.why: Grated pear tenderises beef, and slicing semi-frozen meat thin is a knife skill worth learning.

entries.title: Mapo Tofu
entries.why: The Sichuan classic teaches frying chilli bean paste for colour and a cornstarch slurry for gloss.

entries.title: Lomo Saltado
skills: searing beef in a smoking wok
entries.why: Peru's Chinese-influenced stir-fry joins wok heat with chips fried twice.

entries.title: Murgh Makhani (Butter Chicken)
skills: a tomato, butter and cream sauce
entries.why: A two stage dish of charred marinated chicken and a silky tomato sauce.

entries.title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
skills: frying to 165°F (74°C) in the thickest part
entries.why: Fried chicken asks the cook to joint a bird, brine it and manage oil temperature as cold chicken goes in.

entries.title: Flæskesteg (Danish Roast Pork with Crackling)
skills: slow roasting then a blast for crackling
entries.why: The Danish Christmas roast teaches scoring and the high heat finish that turns rind to crackling.

entries.title: Paella Valenciana
entries.why: The original paella teaches how rice cooks in a wide, shallow pan and the crust at the bottom.

entries.title: Jollof Rice with Chicken
skills: a blended pepper base fried down
rice steamed in the sauce under foil
entries.why: West Africa's celebrated rice teaches cooking rice in a reduced sauce without it turning to mush.

entries.title: Crawfish Étouffée
entries.why: Étouffée uses a lighter roux than gumbo, a lesson in how roux colour changes flavour and thickening.

entries.title: Chicken Paprikash with Nokedli
skills: braising chicken in onion and paprika
finishing with sour cream without splitting
entries.why: Sour cream must be tempered into a hot sauce, and nokedli are the simplest pasta dough of all.

entries.title: Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemon and Olives
skills: a slow braise under a conical lid
entries.why: The tagine shows how a closed vessel braises with very little liquid.

entries.title: Thịt Kho Trứng (Caramel Pork and Eggs)
skills: braising pork belly in coconut water
entries.why: The Vietnamese New Year braise extends caramel cooking to a long, slow braise.

entries.title: Massaman Curry with Beef
skills: pounding a paste with dry spices
entries.why: Pounding a curry paste by hand and braising in coconut milk make the green curry lesson slow and deep.

entries.title: Cochinita Pibil
entries.why: The Yucatecan pit roast, adapted for the oven, teaches marinating with acid and sealed slow cooking.

entries.title: Irish Stew
entries.why: The Irish stew thickens itself with potato, a braise with no flour and no browning.

entries.title: Shepherd's Pie
skills: a braised lamb mince with stock
entries.why: A braised filling under a crisp mash is classic British cooking and a lesson in reducing a filling.

entries.title: Jamaican Oxtail Stew
skills: braising until it falls off the bone
entries.why: Oxtail is full of collagen, and a long braise turns it into a sauce that coats the lips.

entries.title: Boeuf Bourguignon
skills: garnishing with lardons, mushrooms and glazed onions separately
entries.why: The great Burgundian braise brings searing, wine reduction and a classical garnish together.

entries.title: Crème Brûlée
entries.why: The custard every brigade can make, finished with a crisp glass of caramel.

entries.title: Irish Apple Cake with Custard Sauce
skills: a rubbed-in cake batter with apples
crème anglaise cooked to coat the spoon
entries.why: Crème anglaise is the pouring custard behind dozens of desserts, here beside an Irish apple cake.

entries.title: Clafoutis aux Cerises
entries.why: The Limousin cherry pudding is a crêpe batter baked as a custard.

entries.title: Sticky Toffee Pudding
skills: a toffee sauce taken to the right colour
entries.why: The British pudding brings caramel to a sauce and soaks a sponge, a richer malva pudding.

entries.title: Bananas Foster
skills: a butter and brown sugar caramel
entries.why: Born at Brennan's in 1951 and still flamed tableside there, it teaches caramel and a safe flambé in the house where the owner works.

entries.title: Pastel de Tres Leches
skills: a whisked sponge strong enough to soak
an Italian or whipped cream topping
entries.why: A sponge built to drink milk without collapsing teaches why whisked sponges are made the way they are.

entries.title: New York Cheesecake
skills: cooling in the oven to prevent cracks
entries.why: The New York cheesecake is a custard baked low and slow, the opposite of the Basque method.

entries.title: Pavlova
skills: cornflour and vinegar for a marshmallow centre
entries.why: The pavlova teaches meringue: clean bowls, sugar added slowly and a long, cool oven.

entries.title: Tiramisù
skills: a zabaglione cooked over a bain-marie
entries.why: Cooking the yolks to a zabaglione makes the tiramisù safe and lighter, and teaches the bain-marie.

entries.title: Alfajores de Maicena
skills: dulce de leche cooked or bought
entries.why: A crumbly cornflour biscuit teaches tenderness without gluten, filled with dulce de leche.

entries.title: Basbousa
skills: a cold syrup on a hot cake
entries.why: The Egyptian semolina cake shows the syrup rule: one hot, one cold.

entries.title: Black Sesame Tang Yuan
skills: a black sesame and lard filling chilled firm
entries.why: Glutinous rice dough behaves like clay, and the filling must be cold to be wrapped.

entries.title: Ichigo Daifuku
skills: making gyuhi from glutinous rice flour
entries.why: Japanese rice cake is wrapped hot and sticky, a test of quick, light hands.

entries.title: Cendol
entries.why: A Malaysian iced dessert of pandan jelly teaches starch gels and palm sugar syrup.

entries.title: Gulab Jamun
skills: frying at low heat so the centre cooks
entries.why: Frying slowly so the centre cooks before the outside darkens is the lesson of the gulab jamun.

entries.title: Puff-Puff
skills: dropping by hand into oil for round puffs
entries.why: A loose yeasted batter dropped into oil teaches proofing and the hand trick that makes round puffs.

entries.title: Churros con Chocolate
skills: a cooked flour and water paste
entries.why: Churro dough is cooked before frying, a first step toward choux pastry.

entries.title: Beignets
entries.why: New Orleans' café beignet teaches frying an enriched dough so it puffs hollow.

entries.title: Hotteok
skills: a brown sugar, cinnamon and nut filling
entries.why: A filled Korean pancake teaches sealing a sticky dough and pressing it as it browns.

entries.title: Kanelbullar (Swedish Cardamom Cinnamon Buns)
skills: a butter, sugar and cinnamon filling
entries.why: Swedish buns teach a different shaping, twisted and knotted, with fresh ground cardamom.

entries.title: Kolaches
entries.why: The Czech filled bun builds on enriched dough with fillings that must stay in the well.

entries.title: Linzer Torte
entries.why: The Austrian tart teaches a short nut pastry that is too fragile to handle warm.

entries.title: Baklava
entries.why: Baklava unites phyllo handling, clarified butter and the syrup rule.

entries.title: Pecan Pie
skills: a sugar custard set just to a wobble
entries.why: The Southern pie trains the crust and a sweet custard that sets as it cools.

entries.title: Tarte Tatin
entries.why: The upside-down tart is caramel, fruit and pastry together, and a confident flip at the end.

entries.title: Eggs Benedict
skills: a warm butter emulsion held at the right temperature
entries.why: Hollandaise is the first warm emulsion, and Eggs Benedict is where a brunch cook earns a station.

entries.title: Eggs Sardou
entries.why: A New Orleans classic on the Brennan's breakfast menu, it adds artichoke preparation and creamed spinach to hollandaise.

entries.title: Omelette Arnold Bennett
skills: a mornay lightened with hollandaise and cream
an open omelette glazed under the grill
entries.why: The Savoy's open omelette joins two sauces into a glaze, a classic derivative in one pan.

entries.title: Rösti with Fried Eggs
skills: a single slow-fried cake flipped whole
entries.why: A perfect rösti is one cake, crisp outside and tender within, and the flip is a skill of its own.

entries.title: Hummus Msabbaha
skills: cooking dried chickpeas very soft with bicarbonate
entries.why: Tahini whipped with ice water is an emulsion, and silky hummus starts with chickpeas cooked past soft.

entries.title: Shiozake Teishoku (Salted Salmon Breakfast)
skills: cutting a salmon side into portions
entries.why: The Japanese set breakfast teaches portioning a side of salmon and dry salting it to firm the flesh.

entries.title: Gravlax with Hovmästarsås on Rye
skills: a salt, sugar and dill cure by weight
entries.why: Curing by weight is exact and safe, and gravlax is the first cure in the course.

entries.title: Bagels with Home-Cured Lox and Schmear
entries.why: New York's breakfast teaches boiling dough before baking and a second, saltier cure.

entries.title: Longganisa with Garlic Rice
skills: curing with salt, garlic and vinegar
entries.why: Making sausage teaches the ratio of lean to fat, cold grinding and a short cure.

entries.title: Jeonbok-juk (Abalone Rice Porridge)
skills: slow-cooked rice porridge with sesame oil
entries.why: Korea's prized porridge adds shellfish fabrication to the congee lesson.

entries.title: Phở Bò
skills: slicing raw beef thin to cook in the bowl
entries.why: A clear, long-simmered beef broth spiced with charred aromatics is stock work at a higher standard.

entries.title: Waakye with Shito
skills: rice and beans coloured with sorghum leaves
shito, a slow-fried pepper and dried fish oil
entries.why: Ghana's favourite breakfast pairs a coloured rice and beans with a pepper sauce fried for an hour.

entries.title: Masala Dosa
skills: soaking and grinding rice and urad dal
spreading thin on a hot griddle
entries.why: A fermented batter spread paper thin teaches fermentation and the hottest crêpe in the course.

entries.title: Jian Bing
skills: a mung bean and wheat batter
cracking an egg on the crêpe
entries.why: China's street breakfast is a fast crêpe assembled in layers in under two minutes.

entries.title: Tamales Rojos
skills: beating lard into masa until it floats
entries.why: Tamales teach masa preparation by feel, the float test for fat, and steaming in husks.

entries.title: Doubles
skills: a turmeric yeast dough stretched thin and fried
entries.why: Trinidad's street breakfast builds on frying yeast dough and slow curried chickpeas.

entries.title: Pão de Queijo
skills: scalding tapioca starch with milk and oil
entries.why: Brazil's cheese bread is made like choux, a cooked paste beaten with eggs, and rehearses it for the pastry kitchen.

entries.title: Khachapuri Adjaruli
skills: adding egg and butter at the end
entries.why: The Georgian cheese boat teaches a shaped dough that holds a molten centre.

entries.title: Roti Canai with Dhal
skills: a soft oiled dough rested overnight
entries.why: Stretching dough until it is translucent and folding it for layers is lamination by hand.

entries.title: Feteer Meshaltet
entries.why: Egypt's layered pastry is lamination with clarified butter, a bridge to the croissant.

entries.title: Kouglof Alsacien
skills: a rich yeast dough beaten long
a slow proof and an even bake
entries.why: Alsace's Sunday breakfast cake is an enriched dough baked tall in a fluted mould, a step before brioche.

entries.title: Brioche Nanterre
skills: a high butter dough mixed long
entries.why: Brioche is the richest bread dough in the course and teaches how fat changes gluten.

entries.title: Ensaïmadas
entries.why: Mallorca's spiral pastry stretches dough by hand and coils it with lard, a cousin of lamination.

entries.title: Medialunas
entries.why: Argentina's breakfast crescent is a sweet, softer croissant and a first full lamination with a butter block.

entries.title: Croissants
skills: a butter block at the right temperature
entries.why: The croissant is the hallmark of the pastry kitchen, where butter temperature decides every layer.

entries.title: Caesar Salad
skills: coddling eggs or using pasteurised eggs
an anchovy, garlic and oil emulsion
entries.why: Making the dressing by hand teaches the cold emulsion and the safe handling of egg yolk.

entries.title: Salade Lyonnaise
entries.why: The Lyon bistro salad uses warm fat for its vinaigrette, a variation on the emulsion.

entries.title: Vitello Tonnato
skills: a tuna mayonnaise made by hand
entries.why: Mayonnaise made by hand, then flavoured with tuna, is a classic derivative on gently poached veal.

entries.title: Shrimp Rémoulade
skills: boiling shrimp in a seasoned crab boil
entries.why: New Orleans' cold shrimp starter teaches the seafood boil and the Creole mustard style of rémoulade.

entries.title: Chicken Shawarma with Toum
skills: toum, a garlic emulsion with no egg
entries.why: Toum is an emulsion held by garlic alone, a demanding test of slow oil addition.

entries.title: Ceviche Clásico
entries.why: Peru's national dish teaches fish fabrication and the food safety of fish served raw.

entries.title: Pulpo a la Gallega
entries.why: Galicia's octopus teaches how to cook a creature that is either tender or rubber with nothing in between.

entries.title: Fiskekaker (Norwegian Fish Cakes)
skills: a fine fish farce bound with cream and starch
entries.why: Norway's fish cakes introduce a farce, the smooth forcemeat behind mousselines and quenelles.

entries.title: Sushi: Hosomaki, Uramaki and Nigiri
entries.why: Sushi demands perfect rice and confident fish cutting, two skills that take years to master.

entries.title: Pork Rillettes
skills: slow cooking pork in its own fat
entries.why: Rillettes are confit made into a spread, the first charcuterie in the course.

entries.title: Pastrami on Rye
skills: a week-long wet cure of brisket with curing salt
entries.why: The New York deli classic is a full curing project, from brine to smoke to steam.

entries.title: Scotch Eggs
skills: frying to cook the meat through
entries.why: A soft yolk inside fully cooked sausage meat is a lesson in timing two doneness targets at once.

entries.title: Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki and Pita
entries.why: Boning and cubing evenly so every piece cooks at once is basic butchery in a Greek lunch.

entries.title: Tacos al Pastor
entries.why: Mexico City's taco teaches slicing a shoulder into sheets and carving from a vertical stack.

entries.title: Bún Chả
entries.why: Hanoi's lunch is grilled pork in a dipping sauce whose balance of salt, sugar, sour and heat must be judged by tongue.

entries.title: Mul Naengmyeon
skills: a clear beef broth chilled and fat removed
entries.why: Korea's cold noodle soup demands a perfectly clear, fat-free broth, the strictest stock test yet.

entries.title: Khao Soi
skills: a curry paste with dry spices
frying noodles for the crisp topping
entries.why: Chiang Mai's curry noodle soup joins a hand-pounded paste with two textures of noodle.

entries.title: Curry Laksa
skills: a rempah fried until the oil splits
entries.why: The laksa rempah is a paste fried until it splits, cooked into a stock built from prawn shells.

entries.title: Egusi Soup with Pounded Yam
skills: frying ground melon seed in palm oil
pounding yam to a smooth swallow
entries.why: Nigeria's egusi asks for slow-cooked smoked fish stock and a smooth pounded yam made by hand.

entries.title: Feijoada
skills: farofa, couve and orange to serve
entries.why: Brazil's Saturday lunch manages many cuts of pork with different cooking times in one pot.

entries.title: Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani
skills: parboiling basmati to seventy per cent
entries.why: Kacchi biryani cooks raw meat and part-cooked rice together under a seal, a feat of timing.

entries.title: Siu Mai
skills: a springy pork and prawn filling slapped for bounce
entries.why: The dim sum classic teaches the bouncy texture Cantonese cooks prize and an open dumpling fold.

entries.title: Mantı
skills: garlic yoghurt and Aleppo pepper butter
entries.why: Turkish mantı are so small that forty fit on a spoon, the test of rolling thin and working fast.

entries.title: Pierogi Ruskie
entries.why: The Polish dumpling refines the uszka fold with a softer dough and a pan-fried finish.

entries.title: Brik à l'Oeuf
skills: a tuna, caper and parsley filling
cracking an egg onto the pastry
folding and frying so the yolk stays runny
entries.why: Tunisia's brik is a race against time, fried in seconds so the pastry crisps and the yolk stays soft.

entries.title: Steak Frites with Béarnaise
entries.why: Béarnaise is the first classic derivative of hollandaise, served with the bistro dinner every cook should own.

entries.title: New Orleans Barbecue Shrimp
skills: mounting cold butter to an emulsion
entries.why: The buttery New Orleans barbecue shrimp on the Brennan's menu is a lesson in mounting butter without breaking it.

entries.title: Bacalao al Pil Pil
skills: swirling until the fish gelatine emulsifies the oil
entries.why: The Basque emulsion held only by fish gelatine is one of the great technical dishes of Spain.

entries.title: Sole Meunière
entries.why: The dish that converted a generation to French food teaches flatfish skinning and brown butter.

entries.title: Branzino in Salt Crust
skills: a salt and egg white crust
judging doneness through the crust by probe
entries.why: Baking a whole fish sealed in salt teaches cooking by thermometer and carving a round fish.

entries.title: Chả Cá Lã Vọng
entries.why: Hanoi's turmeric fish teaches filleting into even pieces that hold together in the pan.

entries.title: Shui Zhu Yu (Sichuan Water-Boiled Fish)
skills: velveting with egg white and starch
entries.why: Velveting protects thin slices of fish, and the sizzling oil finish is a Sichuan signature.

entries.title: Pla Rad Prik (Crisp Whole Fish with Chilli Sauce)
skills: a sweet, sour and hot chilli sauce
entries.why: Frying a whole fish to crisp fins teaches oil safety at scale and scoring for even cooking.

entries.title: Tempura
skills: an ice cold, barely mixed batter
entries.why: The lightest batter in the world depends on cold, little gluten and oil kept at temperature.

entries.title: Fish and Chips
skills: skinning and portioning haddock or cod
entries.why: Britain's national dish compares a heavier batter with tempura and perfects the double fried chip.

entries.title: Korean Fried Chicken
skills: a gochujang glaze applied at the last moment
entries.why: Double frying for a shell that stays crisp under a glaze shows how starch and moisture behave in oil.

entries.title: Pollo a la Brasa with Ají Verde
skills: a dark beer, cumin and huacatay marinade
entries.why: Removing a backbone and flattening a bird is the first real cut of butchery, here in Peru's favourite chicken.

entries.title: Tandoori Chicken with Naan
skills: a yoghurt naan dough slapped onto a hot surface
entries.why: The tandoor adapted for home asks for extreme heat management and a bread cooked in seconds.

entries.title: Tira de Asado with Chimichurri
skills: building and reading a wood or charcoal fire
entries.why: The Argentine asado is fire management as a craft: embers, distance and patience.

entries.title: Andesteg (Danish Roast Duck with Red Cabbage)
entries.why: A whole duck renders a cup of fat as it roasts, and that fat is the treasure of the dish.

entries.title: Home-Cured Corned Beef and Cabbage
skills: a spiced wet cure of brisket with curing salt over a week
entries.why: The Irish corned beef uses the pastrami cure without smoke, and a white sauce to serve.

entries.title: Sauerbraten
skills: a three day vinegar and wine marinade
a sweet and sour gingerbread sauce
entries.why: The German pot roast is marinated for days, a lesson in what acid does to meat over time.

entries.title: Texas Smoked Brisket
entries.why: The Texas brisket is the longest cook in the course and the purest test of fire control.

entries.title: Osso Buco with Risotto alla Milanese
skills: a saffron risotto stirred to all'onda
entries.why: Milan's shank braise is served with the risotto that teaches starch release and the wave finish.

entries.title: Chiles Rellenos
entries.why: Peeling a charred chile without tearing it and frying in a meringue batter make this a dish of fine hands.

entries.title: Maqluba
entries.why: The upside-down rice of Palestine depends on layering and the nerve to invert a full pot.

entries.title: Fesenjan
skills: a pomegranate molasses braise until the oil rises
entries.why: Persia's walnut and pomegranate stew teaches a long, low cook that turns nuts into a dark, glossy sauce.

entries.title: Couscous with Seven Vegetables and Lamb
skills: steaming couscous three times over the stew
entries.why: Steaming couscous by hand three times is the Moroccan art behind this Friday dish.

entries.title: Thieboudienne
skills: stuffing fish with rof herb paste
rice cooked in the broth with its crust
entries.why: Senegal's national dish cooks fish, vegetables and rice in one pot in the right order.

entries.title: Beef Rendang
skills: simmering beef in coconut milk for hours
cooking on until it fries in its own oil
entries.why: Rendang is cooked past a curry into a dry, dark finish, the fullest lesson in a paste that splits.

entries.title: Semifreddo al Caffè
skills: an Italian meringue with sugar syrup at soft ball
entries.why: Italian meringue made with hot syrup is the cooked meringue every pastry cook must know.

entries.title: Quindim
skills: a very high yolk custard with coconut
entries.why: Brazil's yolk and coconut custard asks for a gentler bake and a perfect unmoulding.

entries.title: Chocoflan
skills: layers that swap places in the oven
entries.why: The Mexican impossible cake works because of density, a lesson in the science of batters.

entries.title: Japanese Cotton Cheesecake
skills: a meringue whipped to soft peaks only
entries.why: The Japanese cheesecake is a soufflé and a cheesecake at once, where an overwhipped meringue cracks the top.

entries.title: Rasmalai
skills: splitting milk with acid for chhena
entries.why: Making fresh cheese and kneading it smooth enough to hold in a syrup is Bengali sweet making at its finest.

entries.title: Kuih Talam Pandan
entries.why: A two layer steamed kuih teaches layered setting and the balance of salt and sweet.

entries.title: Nigerian Coconut Candy
skills: cooking sugar to the right stage
entries.why: Sugar stages read by eye and by spoon are the core of candy making.

entries.title: Suspiro a la Limeña
skills: a manjar blanco of reduced milks
an Italian meringue with port syrup
entries.why: Lima's sigh pairs a slow milk reduction with a port Italian meringue.

entries.title: Bread Pudding Soufflé with Whiskey Sauce
entries.why: The New Orleans bread pudding, on the Brennan's dessert menu, raised into a soufflé teaches the soufflé rise.

entries.title: Tarte au Citron
skills: blind baking to a golden shell
a lemon curd or baked lemon custard
entries.why: The French lemon tart, also on the Brennan's dessert list, demands a perfect sweet pastry and a smooth, sharp filling.

entries.title: Bakewell Tart
skills: a feathered icing or flaked almonds
entries.why: Frangipane is the almond cream behind many French tarts, here in a British classic.

entries.title: Boston Cream Pie
skills: a genoise or hot milk sponge
entries.why: Crème pâtissière, a custard boiled with starch, is learnt here with a ganache, the chocolate emulsion.

entries.title: Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte
entries.why: The German torte teaches splitting a sponge, soaking with syrup and finishing with cream.

entries.title: Profiteroles with Chocolate Sauce
skills: pâte à choux cooked and beaten
filling with ice cream or crème pâtissière
entries.why: Choux is cooked twice, in the pan and the oven, and the profiterole is its first full test.

entries.title: Cannoli Siciliani
entries.why: Sicily's fried shells teach a blistered pastry and why cannoli are filled at the last minute.

entries.title: Chebakia
entries.why: Morocco's Ramadan sweet is shaped by hand into rosettes, a lesson in patience and folding.

entries.title: Yakgwa (Korean Honey Cookies)
skills: a sesame oil dough folded for layers
frying at low then higher heat
entries.why: Korea's honey cookie is fried slowly so the layers open, then soaked, a technique all its own.

entries.title: Knafeh Nabulseyeh
entries.why: Nablus' cheese pastry teaches desalting cheese and the syrup rule once more.

entries.title: Galaktoboureko
entries.why: The Greek custard pie joins a starch-thickened custard with phyllo work.

entries.title: Apfelstrudel
skills: stretching over the backs of the hands until you can read through it
entries.why: Stretching strudel dough to transparency over a tablecloth is one of the great hand skills in pastry.

entries.title: Cantonese Mooncakes
skills: a golden syrup and lye water dough
lotus seed paste and salted yolk
entries.why: The Mid-Autumn mooncake teaches a thin, even crust around a heavy filling and a sharp mould print.

entries.title: Semla
skills: scooping and making almond paste filling
entries.why: The Swedish Lenten bun joins an enriched dough with homemade almond paste.

entries.title: Dan Tat (Hong Kong Egg Tarts)
skills: a water dough and butter dough laminated
a smooth egg custard baked just set
entries.why: Hong Kong's egg tart laminates two doughs and bakes a custard that must not puff.

entries.title: Pastéis de Nata
skills: pressing pastry up the tin with wet thumbs
the hottest oven for blistered tops
entries.why: The Lisbon custard tart asks for laminated dough and an oven hot enough to scorch the custard in spots.

entries.title: Mille-Feuille
skills: puff pastry baked flat under a tray
entries.why: A thousand layers of puff pastry with crème pâtissière and feathered icing close the level as the pastry kitchen's showpiece.

entries.title: Oeufs en Meurette
skills: a meurette sauce reduced from the poaching wine and stock, mounted with butter
entries.why: Burgundy's brunch poaches eggs in wine and turns the poaching liquid into a refined sauce.

entries.title: Eggs Hussarde
skills: a marchand de vin sauce of red wine and veal stock
Holland rusks, Canadian bacon and poached eggs plated to order
entries.why: A Brennan's breakfast signature, it stacks two sauces, one brown and one emulsified, on one plate.

entries.title: Lobster Benedict
skills: dispatching and cooking a live lobster humanely
entries.why: Breaking down a whole lobster and building a perfect Benedict around it is brunch at the top level.

entries.title: Devilled Kidneys on Toast
skills: trimming lamb kidneys of fat and core
a mustard, cayenne and Worcestershire pan sauce
entries.why: The Victorian breakfast teaches offal preparation and the speed of a pan sauce cooked in a minute.

entries.title: Home-Smoked Salmon with Scrambled Eggs and Brown Bread
entries.why: Cold smoking is the most exacting cure in the course, a matter of temperature, time and hygiene.

entries.title: Kaisendon (Market Seafood Rice Bowl)
skills: breaking down a whole fish to sashimi blocks
entries.why: The fish market breakfast of Japan is raw fish cut perfectly, a test of knife, freshness and safety.

entries.title: Korean Breakfast Table with Doenjang Jjigae and Banchan
skills: a doenjang stew from anchovy stock
entries.why: A Korean table of many small dishes is a lesson in planning, sequence and balance across a meal.

entries.title: Turkish Breakfast Spread with Simit and Menemen
skills: simit dipped in pekmez and sesame
olives, cheeses and tomatoes arranged as a spread
entries.why: The Turkish serpme breakfast tests baking, egg cookery and the arrangement of a generous table.

entries.title: Persian Breakfast with Barbari Bread
skills: feta, herbs, walnuts and soft eggs
entries.why: The ridged barbari is shaped by hand and glazed with a cooked paste, bread craft at a higher level.

entries.title: Barbacoa de Borrego with Consomé
skills: wrapping lamb in maguey or banana leaves
steaming over a broth for hours
serving the consomé that caught the drippings
entries.why: Sunday breakfast in central Mexico is lamb steamed in leaves over its own consomé, pit cooking adapted at home.

entries.title: Ewa Agoyin with Agege Bread
skills: cooking beans to a soft mash
a dark pepper sauce fried slowly in palm oil
entries.why: Lagos' bean breakfast with its long-fried pepper sauce and a home-baked loaf is a two day project.

entries.title: Arepas de Huevo
entries.why: The Caribbean coast's egg-filled arepa is fried twice with an egg inside, a feat of handling hot dough.

entries.title: Appam with Kerala Stew
skills: a fermented rice and coconut batter
swirling in an appachatti for lacy edges
a coconut milk stew with whole spices
entries.why: Kerala's lace-edged appam needs a living batter and a pan swirl, with a stew delicately spiced.

entries.title: Bánh Cuốn
skills: a thin rice batter steamed on cloth
a pork and wood ear filling
entries.why: Hanoi's steamed rice rolls ask for sheets so thin they are lifted by stick, the finest work with starch.

entries.title: Har Gow
skills: a wheat starch dough scalded with boiling water
entries.why: The dim sum master's test: a translucent wrapper, a prawn that snaps and pleats counted by the guest.

entries.title: Sheng Jian Bao
skills: a pork aspic set from skin
pan-frying then steaming in the pan
entries.why: Shanghai's breakfast bun holds a soup made from set aspic, crisp below and soft above.

entries.title: Homemade Skyr with Bilberries
entries.why: Culturing milk at a held temperature and straining it thick is fermentation done with care.

entries.title: Sourdough Pancakes from Your Own Starter
skills: raising a starter over ten days
entries.why: Keeping a starter alive is a daily discipline, and these pancakes are its first reward.

entries.title: Weisswurst with Laugenbrezeln and Sweet Mustard
skills: an emulsified veal sausage kept ice cold
a lye bath handled with gloves and goggles
entries.why: Bavaria's second breakfast demands an emulsified sausage and a lye bath, both exact and both handled safely.

entries.title: Msemen and Baghrir with Amlou
skills: a folded square flatbread laminated with butter and semolina
a semolina yeast batter of a thousand holes
entries.why: A Moroccan breakfast of two breads, one laminated and one honeycombed, made side by side.

entries.title: Gaufres de Liège
skills: a brioche dough with pearl sugar folded in last
entries.why: Liège waffles are brioche baked in an iron, where pearl sugar caramelises into the crust.

entries.title: Bougatsa with Hand-Stretched Phyllo
skills: dusting with icing sugar and cinnamon
entries.why: Thessaloniki's breakfast pie asks the cook to make the phyllo too, the strudel lesson taken further.

entries.title: Pastelitos de Guayaba y Queso
entries.why: Havana's café pastry puts homemade puff pastry to work around guava and cheese.

entries.title: Wienerbrød (Danish Pastries)
entries.why: Danish pastry is yeasted lamination with many shapes and fillings, a full morning's bake.

entries.title: Sfogliatelle Ricce
skills: a stiff dough stretched into a long sheet
rolling a tight log with lard
entries.why: Naples' shell pastry is among the hardest in the world, a tight spiral that fans into hundreds of leaves.

entries.title: Tiradito Nikkei
skills: slicing raw fish as for sashimi
an ají amarillo and citrus sauce
entries.why: The Japanese Peruvian plate refines ceviche into sliced sashimi with a sauce, a composed cold starter.

entries.title: Pickled Herring Three Ways
skills: a salt cure then three pickles: mustard, onion and dill, and spiced
entries.why: Pickling fish three ways in one batch is Nordic preserving at the level of a smörgåsbord.

entries.title: Maryland Crab Cakes
skills: binding with as little as possible
entries.why: A crab cake that is nearly all crab teaches binding to the minimum and gentle handling.

entries.title: Creole Turtle Soup
skills: turtle meat or veal braised tender
entries.why: Turtle soup is a Brennan's first course, and making it brings roux, stock and braising to a refined finish.

entries.title: Bouillabaisse with Rouille
skills: a rapid boil to emulsify oil into the broth
entries.why: Marseille's fish stew boils hard to emulsify its oil, the opposite of every other stock in the course.

entries.title: Arroz Negro with Allioli
skills: cleaning cuttlefish and saving the ink
entries.why: Catalonia's black rice teaches cephalopod preparation and an allioli made with no egg at all.

entries.title: Moqueca Baiana
entries.why: Bahia's fish stew is cooked gently in layers and the broth becomes a second dish, the pirão.

entries.title: Banku with Grilled Tilapia and Shito
entries.why: Ghana's chop bar lunch joins a fermented dough with a whole fish grilled over coals.

entries.title: Lahpet Thoke (Burmese Tea Leaf Salad)
skills: frying beans, garlic and lentils for crunch
balancing sour, salty and oily at the table
entries.why: Myanmar's tea leaf salad teaches fermenting leaves and composing many crunchy elements.

entries.title: Bossam with Fresh Kimchi
skills: simmering pork belly with doenjang and coffee
entries.why: Bossam asks for a fresh kimchi made that day and pork belly simmered to slice cleanly.

entries.title: Tafelspitz
skills: simmering beef rump for hours below the boil
entries.why: Vienna's boiled beef is a two course lunch from one pot, a test of clarity, timing and sauce.

entries.title: Hünkar Beğendi
skills: a béchamel with the smoked flesh and kaşar cheese
entries.why: The Ottoman palace dish folds smoked aubergine into a béchamel, a refined variation on a mother sauce.

entries.title: Chelo Kebab Koobideh with Tahdig
skills: kneading lamb mince until it clings to wide skewers
chelo rice steamed with a golden tahdig
entries.why: Iran's national dish asks for mince that holds on a flat skewer and a rice crust lifted out whole.

entries.title: Kibbeh Maqliyeh (Fried Kibbeh)
skills: a fine bulgur and lean lamb shell
hollowing by finger into thin torpedoes
entries.why: Shaping kibbeh shells thin and even by hand is a skill Lebanese cooks spend years refining.

entries.title: Chiles en Nogada
entries.why: Puebla's September dish combines the chile relleno skills with a fresh walnut sauce.

entries.title: Kerala Sadya
skills: planning a dozen dishes on a banana leaf: avial, thoran, sambar, olan, pachadi, payasam
entries.why: The Onam feast of many dishes is a lesson in planning, timing and serving in a set order.

entries.title: Bún Bò Huế
skills: a pork and beef bone broth
entries.why: Hue's spicy beef noodle soup layers lemongrass and shrimp paste over a long bone broth.

entries.title: Tonkotsu Ramen
skills: a pork bone broth boiled hard to emulsify
entries.why: Tonkotsu is boiled hard for an opaque broth, and a ramen bowl has five separate components.

entries.title: Crubeens (Irish Pig's Trotters)
entries.why: Boning out trotters and pressing the meat is nose to tail cooking in an Irish pub classic.

entries.title: Tortellini in Brodo
skills: a pork, prosciutto, mortadella and Parmigiano filling
entries.why: The Emilian Christmas lunch tests a clear broth and the folding of small filled pasta by the hundred.

entries.title: Xiaolongbao
skills: a thin wrapper rolled with a thicker centre
entries.why: The soup dumpling is the summit of Chinese dumpling craft, judged by its pleats and its unbroken skin.

entries.title: Chicken Pastilla
skills: braising chicken with saffron and cinnamon
entries.why: The Fes celebration pie balances sweet and savoury in a crisp case, a showpiece of Moroccan cooking.

entries.title: Coulibiac (Kulebyaka)
skills: salmon, rice, mushrooms and eggs layered with crêpes to absorb juice
entries.why: The Russian fish pie layers many preparations inside pastry, an exercise in managing moisture.

entries.title: Melton Mowbray Pork Pie
skills: a hot water crust raised by hand
filling with stock that sets to jelly
entries.why: The raised pie is a hot water crust shaped by hand and filled with jelly through a hole, a British art.

entries.title: Pâté en Croûte
skills: a pastry lining a hinged mould
entries.why: The summit of French charcuterie, judged by the clean slice of forcemeat, garnish, aspic and crust.

entries.title: Seared Scallops with Black Pudding and Cauliflower Purée
skills: a silky purée passed through a sieve
entries.why: A modern Irish starter of three elements teaches searing to a crust while leaving the centre translucent.

entries.title: Sashimi Moriawase from a Whole Fish
skills: breaking a whole fish into loins
entries.why: Breaking down a whole fish to sashimi is the Japanese chef's highest knife test.

entries.title: Suquet de Peix
skills: a picada of almonds, garlic and bread
entries.why: The Catalan fisherman's stew thickened with picada is the fish cookery of the coast refined.

entries.title: Redfish Courtbouillon
skills: filleting redfish and making stock from the head and frame
entries.why: The Creole courtbouillon brings fish fabrication and roux together in a dish of the Louisiana coast.

entries.title: Hor Mok Pla (Steamed Fish Curry Custard)
skills: a red curry paste pounded by hand
fish and coconut beaten to a mousse with egg
entries.why: The steamed curry custard of the Thai royal kitchen asks for a pounded paste and a delicate set.

entries.title: Porterhouse with Bordelaise Sauce
skills: carving strip and fillet off the bone
a bordelaise from a red wine and shallot reduction, demi-glace and bone marrow
entries.why: The steakhouse porterhouse teaches thermometer cooking and the classical brown sauce derivative.

entries.title: Wang Galbi (Butterflied Grilled Short Ribs)
skills: butterflying short ribs into long ribbons on the bone
entries.why: Cutting a short rib into a long, even ribbon on its bone is a Korean butchery skill done by hand.

entries.title: Venison Loin with Juniper Sauce and Lingonberries
skills: searing and roasting to medium rare
a game sauce with juniper and a little chocolate
entries.why: Lean game cooked rare with a reduced sauce is a lesson in carryover and resting a loin.

entries.title: Carré d'Agneau Persillé with Pommes Anna
skills: pommes Anna sliced thin and layered
entries.why: Frenching a rack and building pommes Anna show precision with knife and oven.

entries.title: Coniglio alla Ligure
skills: braising with wine, olives, pine nuts and herbs
entries.why: Jointing a rabbit is a refined butchery skill, and the lean saddle teaches cooking to the right minute.

entries.title: Svíčková na Smetaně
skills: puréeing and passing the sauce with cream
entries.why: Bohemia's Sunday dinner turns the braising vegetables into a passed, silky cream sauce.

entries.title: Matambre Arrollado
skills: a filling of eggs, carrots and peppers
entries.why: Rolling and tying a stuffed flank so every slice shows a pattern is classic butchery work.

entries.title: Jerk Chicken over Pimento Wood
skills: a Scotch bonnet and allspice marinade
entries.why: Jamaican jerk combines a fiery marinade with live fire and smoke, a test of heat in every sense.

entries.title: Siu Yuk (Cantonese Crackling Pork Belly)
skills: blanching and pricking the skin all over
entries.why: The Cantonese roast meat counter's crackling is the most exacting skin in the course.

entries.title: Steak and Kidney Pudding
skills: a raw filling of beef and trimmed kidney
entries.why: The steamed British pudding asks for a suet crust that holds a braise cooked inside it.

entries.title: Javaher Polow (Jewelled Rice) with Saffron Chicken
skills: parboiling and steaming rice with tahdig
entries.why: The Persian wedding rice is the most refined rice in the course, a jewel box of candied and tart garnishes.

entries.title: Dum Pukht Raan (Slow-Cooked Leg of Lamb)
skills: trimming and piercing a whole leg
entries.why: Lucknow's sealed slow cooking applied to a whole leg of lamb is dum at its grandest.

entries.title: Bebek Betutu (Balinese Spiced Duck)
skills: a basa genep paste pounded from many roots
stuffing and coating a whole duck
entries.why: Bali's ceremonial duck is wrapped and cooked for hours in a paste of a dozen aromatics.

entries.title: Palm Nut Soup with Fufu
skills: extracting palm fruit cream by hand
a light soup with smoked fish and goat
entries.why: Abenkwan made from the palm fruit and fufu pounded by hand is a Ghanaian dinner of real labour.

entries.title: Hamam Mahshi (Stuffed Squab)
skills: poaching then roasting to a crisp skin
entries.why: Egypt's stuffed pigeon asks for careful work on a very small bird.

entries.title: Agnolotti del Plin with Sugo d'Arrosto
entries.why: Piedmont's pinched pasta with a roast jus is restaurant pasta at its most refined.

entries.title: Mole Negro Oaxaqueño
entries.why: Oaxaca's black mole is the most complex sauce in the course and a day of patient work.

entries.title: Peking Duck with Mandarin Pancakes
entries.why: The imperial duck needs a dried, glazed skin that shatters and a carving done at the table.

entries.title: Chicken Ballotine with Mushroom Mousseline
skills: boning a whole chicken through the back
entries.why: Boning a whole bird intact and filling it with a mousseline is the classical butchery exam.

entries.title: Beef Wellington
skills: resting and slicing to a perfect pink
entries.why: The Wellington joins puff pastry, duxelles and exact beef doneness in one slice, the final dinner of the course.

entries.title: Christmas Pudding with Brandy Butter
entries.why: The British pudding is made weeks ahead and steamed for hours, a lesson in maturing and planning.

entries.title: Bastani Sonnati (Saffron and Rosewater Ice Cream)
skills: a saffron custard base cooked to 180°F (82°C)
entries.why: Churning a custard base teaches ice crystal control, with Persian saffron and rose.

entries.title: Eight Treasure Rice Pudding
skills: arranging dried fruits in a pattern
entries.why: The Chinese New Year pudding is a plated pattern that must survive being turned out.

entries.title: Jalebi with Rabri
skills: rabri reduced from milk for hours
entries.why: A crisp fermented spiral soaked in syrup beside a slow-reduced milk is a composed plate of contrasts.

entries.title: Halawet el Jibn
skills: melting cheese into a semolina dough
entries.why: The sweet cheese rolls of Hama are rolled while hot, a dough that fights back.

entries.title: Ekmek Kataifi
skills: layering in a dish to slice clean
entries.why: Three layers of very different textures sliced clean make this Greek dessert a plating exercise.

entries.title: Goxua
entries.why: The Basque layered dessert is plated in a glass where every layer must be seen.

entries.title: Matcha Mille Crêpe Cake
skills: twenty or more identical thin crêpes
entries.why: Twenty identical crêpes stacked perfectly level is a test of consistency more than flair.

entries.title: Japanese Strawberry Shortcake
skills: a genoise whisked over warm water
cream whipped to the right peak
smooth masking with a palette knife
entries.why: The Japanese Christmas cake demands a flawless genoise and a smooth cream finish.

entries.title: Chajá
entries.why: Uruguay's meringue cake balances soft and crisp textures in one slice.

entries.title: Torta Rogel
skills: rolling and baking many paper thin layers
entries.why: Argentina's celebration cake asks for a dozen crisp layers stacked with dulce de leche.

entries.title: Sans Rival
skills: cashew dacquoise layers piped and baked
a French buttercream made with hot syrup and yolks
entries.why: The Filipino dacquoise cake teaches French buttercream, the richest emulsion in pastry.

entries.title: Medovik
skills: a honey dough cooked over a bain-marie
entries.why: The Russian honey cake is baked crisp and softened by its frosting over a day.

entries.title: Lapis Legit
skills: a spiced butter and yolk batter
baking eighteen thin layers one at a time under the grill
entries.why: The Indonesian thousand layer cake is baked one layer at a time, a lesson in patience and evenness.

entries.title: Dobos Torta
skills: a caramel top cut into wedges before it sets
entries.why: Budapest's layered torte asks for a caramel cut at exactly the right moment.

entries.title: M'hencha (Moroccan Almond Snake)
entries.why: Morocco's coiled almond pastry tests phyllo handling at length without a tear.

entries.title: Cassata Siciliana
entries.why: Sicily's Easter cake is a baroque exercise in marzipan, fondant and decoration.

entries.title: Turrón de Alicante
skills: cooking honey and sugar to the hard crack stage
entries.why: The hard almond nougat of Alicante joins a sugar syrup at the hard crack stage with meringue, candy making at its most exact.

entries.title: Prinsesstårta
entries.why: The Swedish princess cake requires a domed cream and a seamless marzipan cover.

entries.title: Doberge Cake
skills: a cooked chocolate or lemon custard filling
a poured fondant or ganache shell
entries.why: New Orleans' layered celebration cake joins many thin layers with custard under a glossy shell.

entries.title: Baked Alaska
skills: homemade ice cream frozen hard in a dome
an Italian meringue piped and torched
entries.why: Ice cream inside hot browned meringue is a dish of temperatures and timing.

entries.title: Sachertorte
skills: a chocolate sponge raised with meringue
a cooked chocolate glaze poured in one motion
entries.why: Vienna's chocolate cake asks for a glaze poured once and left untouched, perfect or not.

entries.title: Macarons
entries.why: Macarons punish every error of measure, fold and oven, and reward exactness.

entries.title: Gâteau Opéra
entries.why: The Opéra is layers of perfection measured in millimetres, the pastry kitchen's final exam on chocolate.

entries.title: Paris-Brest
entries.why: Choux, caramel and a praline mousseline close the course with the great French pastry classic.
